layout.arrangement: Thin dark-red rectangular frame insets the whole slide. Top-right: yellow slide-number circle (32). Top-left: white rounded panel with red border containing the vector-matrix equation (input pill, 4x4 weight matrix, equals sign, output column). Top-right-center: red title with blue italic subtitle. Center: large red-outlined elbow block arrow pointing from the title down into the diagram. Bottom-right: large blue-bordered rounded panel containing a fully-connected-network diagram (4 output circles on top, gray weight-label band in the middle, 4 input circles on bottom).

regions.name: Red frame border

regions.name: Equation panel

layout.hierarchy: 1) Network diagram dominates by area and its blue border draws the eye; 2) equation panel (white box, red border) anchors top-left; 3) title is the largest text (red) with blue subtitle second; 4) elbow arrow is a large connective glyph; 5) smallest: dimension labels 1xd/dxd and the 32 badge. Red is the dominant accent color, blue secondary, yellow only on the badge.

visual_elements.description: Equation panel: rounded rectangle, white fill, dark-red ~2.5pt border, corner radius ~15px. Contents left to right: (a) pale pink-lavender rounded pill containing four small white circles with red borders labeled X_21, X_22, X_23, X_24 (black bold, subscripts); (b) red bold 'X_2' (subscript 2) below the pill, tiny red '1xd' at the pill's lower right; (c) red bold 'W_Q' (subscript Q) below X_2; (d) the 4x4 matrix (separate element); (e) tiny red 'dxd' at the matrix bottom-right; (f) red bold '=' sign; (g) vertical 4x1 output vector of four pink rounded cells with dark-maroon text X_Q21, X_Q22, X_Q23, X_Q24.

4x4 matrix of ~38x42px cells, pale-yellow fill, 1pt orange borders. Cell texts (bold, subscripted) with font colors - Row 1: W_11 (blue), W_21 (magenta), W_31 (orange), W_41 (green). Row 2: W_12, W_22, W_32, W_42 (all magenta/purple). Row 3: W_13, W_23, W_33, W_43 (all orange). Row 4: W_14, W_24, W_34, W_44 (all green). Subscript convention: first digit = input index (varies across columns), second digit = output index (varies down rows).

Large elbow/bent block arrow, white fill, dark-red ~2.5pt outline. Horizontal tail segment directly below the subtitle; shaft bends 90 degrees downward and terminates in a broad triangular arrowhead pointing straight down at the network panel.

Fully-connected layer diagram inside a blue-bordered rounded rectangle (no fill). TOP ROW (outputs): four ~44px circles, white fill, blue 2pt borders, black bold subscripted labels X_Q21, X_Q22, X_Q23, X_Q24 at x ~56%, 67.5%, 78.6%, 88.8% width, y ~52%; small colored arc marks hug the bottom edge of X_Q21 (red), X_Q22 (blue), X_Q24 (green). MIDDLE: light-gray rounded band (#D9D9D9, no border) spanning ~51%-93% width, ~56.5%-79% height, containing red bold 'W_Q' at its left edge plus weight labels: red W_11, W_12, W_13, W_14 stepping down-right; blue W_21, W_22, plus a second blue label read as W_21 (possibly W_23) [?]; green W_41, W_42, W_43, W_44 stepping down-right; a small dark-navy arrowhead sits mid-diagram (~72% width, ~64% height) on a blue line pointing down-left. BOTTOM ROW (inputs): four ~44px circles, gray fill #C0C0C0, red 2pt borders, black bold labels X_21, X_22, X_23, X_24 at the same x positions, y ~85.5%. CONNECTIONS: thin ~1pt lines from every input circle to every output circle (16 total) passing behind the gray band; lines from X_21 are red, from X_22 blue, from X_24 green; lines from X_23 are faint/unlabeled (no W_31-W_34 labels shown).
Slide-number badge: yellow circle ~36px diameter with black '32' centered.

imagery: No photographs, icons, or illustrations; all visuals are flat vector shapes (circles, rounded rectangles/pills, matrix grid cells, one block arrow, connector lines).
typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Calibri-like). Title ~22pt bold red; subtitle ~20pt bold italic blue; all math tokens (X, W) bold with numeric/letter subscripts (e.g., X_21, W_Q, X_Q21); dimension labels 1xd and dxd are tiny (~9pt) red; slide number plain black. No serif fonts, no all-caps, no numbered bullets; heavy reliance on subscript formatting and color-coded math text.
animation_state: No dimmed or ghosted placeholder elements; slide appears fully revealed. Caveat: the network diagram labels weights for inputs 1, 2 and 4 (red W_1x, blue W_2x, green W_4x) but shows no W_31-W_34 labels for input X_23 - either a deliberate omission or a paused build step.
recreation_brief: 1. Slide: 16:9, background light gray #E8E8E8. Draw a no-fill rectangle with 2.5pt dark-red #C00000 outline inset ~4% left/right, ~8% top, ~2% bottom as the frame. 2. Top-right (~92% width, ~14% height): yellow #FFD500 oval ~0.9in with black bold '32' (Arial 14pt). 3. Top-left: rounded rectangle, white fill, 2.5pt #C00000 border, from ~5.5% to ~48.5% width and ~13% to ~50% height. 4. Inside it, top-left: pale pink-lavender #EFD9EF rounded pill holding four white circles (1.5pt red borders) labeled X_21, X_22, X_23, X_24 (black bold 9pt, subscripted). 5. Below the pill: red bold 'X_2' (subscript 2, ~18pt); tiny red '1xd' at the pill's lower right; red bold 'W_Q' (subscript Q) below X_2. 6. Build the 4x4 matrix right of the pill (~23%-39% width, ~16%-47.5% height): cells ~0.4in, fill #FDF3C0, 1pt orange #E0A048 borders; texts bold 10pt with subscripts and colors - row 1: W_11 #2020C0, W_21 #B020B0, W_31 #E07020, W_41 #1A8A1A; row 2: W_12, W_22, W_32, W_42 all #B020B0; row 3: W_13, W_23, W_33, W_43 all #E07020; row 4: W_14, W_24, W_34, W_44 all #1A8A1A. Add tiny red 'dxd' at the matrix bottom-right. 7. Red bold '=' (~20pt) right of the matrix; then a vertical stack of four pink #F9C9D4 rounded cells with dark-maroon bold text X_Q21, X_Q22, X_Q23, X_Q24. 8. Title: 'Linear Transformation' in #CC0000 bold ~22pt centered at ~73% width, ~24% height; directly below, '(= Fully connected Layer)' in #2020C0 bold italic ~20pt. 9. Insert a block arrow (elbow/bent type), white fill, 2.5pt #C00000 outline, tail horizontal below the subtitle bending downward, arrowhead pointing down into the network panel (~51%-60% width, ~27%-44.5% height). 10. Network panel: rounded rectangle, no fill, 2.5pt #2020C0 border, ~50%-94.5% width, ~45.5%-93.5% height. 11. Top row at y ~52%: four ~0.45in circles, white fill, 2pt blue borders, black bold subscripted labels X_Q21, X_Q22, X_Q23, X_Q24 at x ~56%, 67.5%, 78.6%, 88.8%; add small arc marks at the bottom edge of X_Q21 (red), X_Q22 (blue), X_Q24 (green). 12. Middle: rounded rectangle #D9D9D9, no border, ~51%-93% width, ~56.5%-79% height; place red bold 'W_Q' at its left edge; weight labels bold 10pt with subscripts: red W_11, W_12, W_13, W_14 stepping down-right; blue W_21, W_22 (and the third blue label as seen, read W_21, likely intended W_23); green W_41, W_42, W_43, W_44 stepping down-right. 13. Bottom row at y ~85.5%: four ~0.45in circles, gray #C0C0C0 fill, 2pt red borders, black bold labels X_21, X_22, X_23, X_24 aligned under the top circles. 14. Connect every bottom circle to every top circle with ~1pt lines sent behind the gray band: red lines from X_21, blue from X_22, faint orange from X_23 (unlabeled), green from X_24; add the small dark-navy arrowhead on a blue line near ~72% width, ~64% height pointing down-left. 15. Use Arial throughout; apply subscript formatting to all numeric/letter subscripts; keep red as the dominant accent, blue secondary, yellow only on the badge.
